headline: REDEMPLO momentum builds while losses deepen on R&D scale-up
summary_short: Arrowhead's fiscal Q3 revenue climbed 171% y/y and 2.1% q/q to $75.3M as the REDEMPLO U.S. launch kept building, while net loss attributable to the company widened to $194.3M (-$1.36 diluted EPS) on higher R&D and SG&A spend.
summary_long: Revenue rose 2.1% q/q and 171% y/y to $75.3M, driven by continued REDEMPLO U.S. commercial momentum — prescription volume roughly doubled in the quarter with over 400 unique prescribers now on board — plus new EC and Australian TGA marketing authorizations. R&D expense climbed to $198.2M (from $162.4M y/y) and SG&A to $47.1M (from $30.9M y/y), pushing the operating loss up 20.4% q/q to $170.1M. Net loss attributable to Arrowhead widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M ($1.36 diluted loss per share), amplified by a $15.4M net-income allocation to noncontrolling interest this quarter versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year earlier. Stockholders' equity fell 24.2% q/q to $465.5M. The release gives no forward financial guidance.
